expectations.text: Explains that a dedicated send for a sponsor is commercial email under US rules

expectations.evidence: It says the list was collected for the newsletter and that click data shared with a third party is a different purpose. It never says newsletter consent fails to cover a sponsor send. It proposes sending to Germany with documented marketing opt-in.
